approval: Deployment blocked until the High risks are fixed and re-tested; exception only by the AI governance board / CISO

risks.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.10 (privacy), 2.7 (security); NIST AI 600-1: Data Privacy, Information Security
controls: Document-level access control in retrieval: users only get documents they are cleared for
Output filter that blocks secrets and personal data (regex / NER) before the answer is shown
Remove credentials and personal contacts from the assistant's knowledge base

risks.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5 (validity), 2.6 (safe failure beyond knowledge limits); NIST AI 600-1: Confabulation
controls: Grounding check: only answer when the retrieved documents support the answer
Show the source document with every answer
Standard fallback message that points to HR or the IT Service Desk

risks.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5 (valid and reliable); NIST AI 600-1: Human-AI Configuration

risks.risk: Over-refusal (assistant too cautious to be useful)
risks.framework: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.5 (valid and reliable)
